title: The derived Cartesian sum mate satisfies the sheaf right-derived unit equation
statement: Let A be any commutative ring and let (b,q,p,v) be a Cartesian square of arbitrary schemes with b,v etale. Form the sheaf sum base-change isomorphism beta:S_v p^* -> q^* S_b [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map, def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] and its right mate theta:q_* S_v -> S_b p_*. In the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], let sumEx be inverse sum mate of the exact-derived inverse-image composition square, assume sumEx invertible, and let gamma be the proper-image-side mate of inverse sumEx [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. Precomposing gamma with the canonical unit for Rq_* followed by D(S_v) equals Q_h of degreewise theta followed by the canonical unit for D(S_b) followed by Rp_*. The precise factors are in the Lean statement. No properness, separatedness, compactification, Noetherianity, boundedness, or coefficient finiteness is used.

proof.text: Use the composite leftAdjointUniq unit identity and iterated-mates identity to identify beta inverse with the inverse sheaf sum mate.
Apply exact_localization_inverse_mate to identify inverse sumEx with the exact-derived square of beta, including its chosen comparison isomorphisms.

The exact-derived-square Q_h component formula satisfies the normalization hypothesis of derivedExact_mateEquiv_app_fac. Apply that theorem to the q and p inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions, then cancel exact localization factors. The canonical composite right-derived unit formulas yield the stated natural-transformation equality componentwise.

theorem cartesian_sum_mate_units
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {W Y' Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : W ⟶ Y') (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (b : W ⟶ Z) [Etale b]
    (v : Y' ⟶ Y) [Etale v]
    (sq : IsPullback b q p v)
    [IsIso (((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        sq.toCommSq).hom)).natTrans)] :
    let θ := (mateEquiv
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (etaleLowerShriekBaseChangeIso A sq).hom)).natTrans
    let sumEx := ((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.toCommSq).hom)).natTrans
    let gam := (mateEquiv
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (inv sumEx))).natTrans
    (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryUnit
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
      (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)) ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh gam =
    Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory θ (.up ℤ)) DerivedCategory.Qh ≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompRightDerivedFunctorUnit
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
